title: glab api user
description: The caller's user, whose username kit reads as the caller's login in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh` (forge/gitlab:me, which forge/gitlab:require runs); `glab api --include user` (forge/gitlab:quota) prints the same body after the headers, and kit reads only its RateLimit headers there. The types are APIEntitiesUserPublic of GET /api/v4/user in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, as https://docs.gitlab.com/api/users/ describes it.
